title: Prove nball_volume_scaling for n-ball volume formula

problemStatement.plain: Prove that the volume of the n-dimensional ball of radius r equals r^n times the unit ball volume. This is the axiom nball_volume_scaling in area-of-circle-oq-02.
whyMatters: Confirms Mathlib's EuclideanSpace.volume_ball is the right primitive
Documents a subtle bug in the original axiom at n=0, r=0

knownResults.goal: Prove Vol(Bⁿ(r)) = rⁿ · π^(n/2) / Γ(n/2+1) for all n ≥ 1

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Proved for n ≥ 1 using EuclideanSpace.volume_ball from Mathlib. Bridge: (√π)^n = π^(n/2) via rpow laws. Discovered parent axiom is false at n=0, r=0.
builtItems: AreaOfCircleOQ02OQ01.lean:123 — negative example: axiom false at n=0,r=0
insights: Mathlib's EuclideanSpace.volume_ball uses √π^n/Γ(n/2+1) while gallery uses π^(n/2)/Γ(n/2+1); these are equal by (√π)^n = π^(n/2)
EuclideanSpace.volume_ball requires [Nonempty ι], limiting to n ≥ 1
Parent axiom nball_volume_scaling is false at n=0, r=0: 0^0=1 in ℝ but ball(0,0)=∅ has measure 0
ENNReal.ofReal_pow and ofReal_mul are the key lemmas for bridging ENNReal and ℝ arithmetic
nextSteps: Fix parent AreaOfCircleOQ02.lean: replace axiom with theorem with hypothesis (hn : 0 < n)
